1998-03-06 minus 37 weeks and 1 day = minus (37*7 + 1) = minus 260 days.  
1998 is not a leap year (leap years: divisible by 4 but not by 100 unless divisible by 400).  
260 days before 1998-03-06:  
Back to 1998-02-04 (31 days from Mar 6), then 260 - 31 = 229 days earlier into 1997.  
1997 is not leap (1996 was leap), so from 1997-12-31 back 229 days:  
229 days = Jan 31 (31) + Dec 31 (31) + Nov 30 (30) + Oct 31 (31) + Sep 30 (30) + Aug 31 (31) + Jul 31 (31) + 24 days left → 24 days before Jul 31 = 1997-07-07.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1997-07-07
